subject.title: fix: anchor JSON Schema patterns for llama.cpp HTTP server compatibility

question: How should OpenClaw identify providers that require fully anchored tool-schema patterns without treating every local endpoint as llama.cpp?
rationale: Locality is not a provider capability, while exposing or automatically selecting a new schema-compatibility field affects provider configuration and long-term compatibility ownership.

options.title: Explicit compatibility capability
options.body: Expose or reuse a model/provider compatibility field and enable it only in documented llama.cpp configurations, preserving existing behavior elsewhere.

options.title: First-class llama.cpp identity
options.body: Add a recognized provider-family or plugin-owned llama.cpp route that selects the compatibility behavior automatically.

options.title: All local endpoints
options.body: Accept the branch's locality heuristic and intentionally change schema semantics for every local OpenAI-compatible server.

recommendation.title: Explicit compatibility capability
recommendation.body: Expose or reuse a model/provider compatibility field and enable it only in documented llama.cpp configurations, preserving existing behavior elsewhere.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent work owns the central OpenAI-completions compatibility-default and endpoint-classification surface.
